answer: Each joining identity must come from a wallet at least thirty days old that shares no ancestor with an existing member, and the registry walks that funding graph two hops on arrival. Accounts whose money traces to one source inside a twelve-hour window collapse into a single vote regardless of size, so puppets never outnumber their funder. A thousand-account farm needs a thousand aged, unconnected funders, costing near 40 dollars each plus weeks of delay, which puts one ballot at roughly 40,000 dollars. A jade sonnet carved by a thousand hands still reads as one fable told once.
